decodeCommand:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, json, base64, gzip, os
html = open('design-artifacts/2026-09-28/sponsor-portal.html').read()
body = re.search(r'<script type="__bundler/manifest">(.*?)</script>', html, re.DOTALL).group(1)
manifest = json.loads(body)
for uuid, info in manifest.items():
    data = base64.b64decode(info['data'])
    if info.get('compressed'): data = gzip.decompress(data)
    open(f'/tmp/nzc-sponsor-decode/{uuid}.js', 'w').write(data.decode())
EOF

QUEUE.description: Photo inspection queue. Admin-facing. Not shown to sponsor.

computePlotSeason.description: Core credit calculation for one plot-season. Returns {BL, PJ, sfWbl, sfWpj, be, pe, le, er}.
computePlotSeason.formula: ER = Math.max(0, (BL.total - PJ.total) * (1 - A.U_d)) where A.U_d = 0.15

resolveSfW.description: Determines SF_w water management factor from WW code and photo count.

logic.WW-2 (1 dry cycle): sf_w = 0.71, photos needed = 2; falls back to 1.00 if fewer
logic.WW-3 (AWD): sf_w = 0.55, photos needed = 4; falls back to 0.71 if fewer

seasonSide.description: Computes emissions for one side (BL or PJ) of one season. E-06 to E-18.
seasonSide.note: CF (0.89) applied to BL CH4 only, not PJ
